# ShortListed

> Curated Amazon deal finder — filter hidden discounts by department, price, discount and reviews, plus seasonal gift guides.

ShortListed (shortlis.vercel.app) helps shoppers discover deeply discounted, well-reviewed Amazon products. The home page is an interactive deal finder; the /deals hub links to editorial guides for major shopping seasons (Black Friday, Prime Day, Christmas, Mother's Day, Father's Day, etc.). As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases.

## Pages

- [Home — Amazon Discount Finder](/): Filter Amazon deals by department, discount, price and review tier.
- [Deals Hub](/deals): Browse all seasonal Amazon gift guides and deal collections.

## Optional

- [Subscribe](/): Use the Subscribe button in the header to join the email list (2-3 curated updates per month).
